story.iWant: a random agent that takes actions uniformly at random
story.soThat: I can establish the lower bound of performance (no learning baseline)

subtasks.subtask: Inherit from Agent abstract base class
Ignore observation (random baseline doesn't use it)
Write comprehensive NumPy-style docstring for RandomAgent
Add tests to tests/test_agent.py or create new test file
Test different sequences with different seeds
Verify actions are in valid range [0, 1, 2]

criterion.given: Agent abstract base class from Story 2.1
criterion.when: I create RandomAgent class in src/funcbench/agent.py

criterion.description: __init__ accepts optional seed parameter with type hint: seed: int | None = None - Random seed for reproducible random actions
__init__ initializes random number generator: If seed provided use np.random.default_rng(seed), if seed is None use np.random.default_rng() (non-deterministic)
get_action(observation: dict) returns random integer from {0, 1, 2} (left, stay, right) using self.rng.integers(0, 3) for sampling
Random actions are uniformly distributed (equal probability for each action)
With same seed, agent produces identical action sequences across runs
Class includes NumPy-style docstring explaining random baseline purpose

doc.title: Epic 3: Baseline Agents & Evaluation
doc.snippet: RandomAgent establishes floor performance baseline. Uses np.random.default_rng() for reproducible random action generation. Agent ignores observation completely and samples uniformly from {0, 1, 2}.

doc.title: Architecture - Reproducibility
doc.snippet: Same seed produces identical results across runs. Use np.random.default_rng(seed) for new NumPy random API. Test shows RandomAgent(seed=42) must produce identical action sequences.

doc.title: Architecture - Agent System
doc.snippet: Agent ABC in agent.py. RandomAgent implements get_action() returning int from {0, 1, 2}. Agent receives observation dict but random baseline ignores it completely.

doc.title: Architecture - Testing Standards
doc.snippet: Use pytest with fixtures. Reproducibility tests critical for research use. Validate deterministic behavior with seeds, uniform distribution over many samples.

artifact.reason: Base class that RandomAgent must inherit from. Defines get_action() abstract method with observation dict parameter.
Action constants (0, 1, 2) that RandomAgent.get_action() must return.
Existing tests for Agent interface. RandomAgent tests should follow similar patterns for consistency.
Example pattern for implementing Agent subclass. Shows correct signature and inheritance pattern.

constraints.constraint: Must use np.random.default_rng() for random number generation, NOT legacy np.random.seed()
Must inherit from Agent abstract base class
Must implement get_action(observation: dict) -> int method
Return value must be in {0, 1, 2} corresponding to ACTION_LEFT, ACTION_STAY, ACTION_RIGHT
Must include NumPy-style docstring with Parameters, Returns, Examples sections
Follow project naming: PascalCase for RandomAgent class, snake_case for methods
Type hints required for all parameters and return values
Seed parameter must enable deterministic reproducibility for scientific research

interface.name: Agent.get_action
interface.description: Must be implemented by RandomAgent. Takes observation dict, returns action code 0/1/2.

interface.name: RandomAgent.__init__
interface.description: Initialize RandomAgent with optional seed for reproducibility.

interface.name: np.random.Generator.integers
interface.description: Use for uniform random sampling: self.rng.integers(0, 3) returns 0, 1, or 2.

tests.standards: Use pytest framework with fixtures from conftest.py. Follow existing test patterns in test_agent.py. Test classes use TestClassName format. Validate deterministic behavior with seeds, type correctness, and statistical properties (uniform distribution). All tests must pass consistently across multiple runs.

test.name: test_random_agent_reproducibility
test.description: Verify same seed produces identical action sequences across multiple runs. Create two RandomAgent instances with seed=42, call get_action() 100 times each, assert sequences match exactly.

test.name: test_different_seeds_produce_different_sequences
test.description: Verify different seeds produce different action sequences. Create RandomAgent(seed=42) and RandomAgent(seed=99), collect 100 actions each, assert sequences differ.

test.name: test_actions_in_valid_range
test.description: Verify all actions are in {0, 1, 2}. Generate 1000 random actions, assert each is either 0, 1, or 2.

test.name: test_uniform_distribution
test.description: Verify uniform distribution of actions. Generate 3000 actions (large N), count occurrences of each action, assert each appears approximately 1000 times (±10% tolerance for randomness).

test.name: test_random_agent_inherits_from_agent
test.description: Verify RandomAgent is instance of Agent. Create agent = RandomAgent(), assert isinstance(agent, Agent).

test.name: test_get_action_signature
test.description: Verify get_action has correct type hints. Check parameter annotation is dict and return annotation is int using inspect.signature().

test.name: test_random_agent_has_docstring
test.description: Verify RandomAgent and get_action have comprehensive docstrings. Check docstring exists, length > 50 chars, mentions "random", "baseline", "seed", "reproducibility".

test.name: test_ignores_observation
test.description: Verify RandomAgent ignores observation dict. Create agent with seed, call get_action() with different observations, assert actions depend only on seed not observation content.
